scenarios.title: A｜保持中立
scenarios.setting: 两个同事因为项目安排发生争执，其中一人转向玩家。

turns.text: Alex, you were in that meeting. Tell her I’m right.

turns.prompt: 你想礼貌说明自己不接受或不方便，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’d rather not take sides here.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d rather not take sides here.
feedback.explanation: “take sides”表示在争执中选边站；拒绝这样做，可以把讨论重新引向具体事情。

choices.text: I don’t think I know enough to say who’s right.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t think I know enough to say who’s right.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: I can tell you what I heard in the meeting, but I don’t want to take sides.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can tell you what I heard in the meeting, but I don’t want to take sides.
feedback.explanation: “take sides”表示在争执中选边站；拒绝这样做，可以把讨论重新引向具体事情。

choices.text: I think you two need to work this out between yourselves.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think you two need to work this out between yourselves.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Don’t pull me into your fight.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’d rather not take sides here.
feedback.explanation: 这句能明确拒绝卷入争执；“I’d rather stay neutral”在普通同事分歧中语气更缓和。

turns.text: You heard what the manager said though, right?

turns.prompt: 你想说明双方对同一信息可能有不同理解，会怎么说？

choices.text: I did, but I think we’re interpreting it differently.

feedback.naturalExpression: I did, but I think we’re interpreting it differently.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Yes. I can explain what I remember, but that’s all.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. I can explain what I remember, but that’s all.
feedback.explanation: “I remember”说明自己记得的情况，便于与对方一起核对经过。

choices.text: I don’t want to speak for the manager. Maybe we should ask them directly.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t want to speak for the manager. Maybe we should ask them directly.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: Honestly, I think getting clarification would be better than arguing about it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Honestly, I think getting clarification would be better than arguing about it.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

turns.prompt: 你想回应向经理核实的提议，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yeah, I think that’s the best option.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, I think that’s the best option.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Good. Then we’ll all have the same information.

feedback.naturalExpression: Good. Then we’ll all have the same information.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

scenarios.title: B｜试图调解
scenarios.setting: 在“两个同事吵架”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“试图调解”。

turns.text: You changed the schedule without asking anyone!
Because nobody was making a decision!

turns.prompt: 你想提醒大家把讨论拉回问题本身，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay, I think we’re getting a little off track here.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, I think we’re getting a little off track here.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Can we slow down for a second and figure out what actually happened?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can we slow down for a second and figure out what actually happened?
feedback.explanation: “figure out”表示想明白或弄清楚，强调经过思考找到办法。

choices.text: I think you both have different understandings of what was agreed.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think you both have different understandings of what was agreed.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Maybe we can focus on how to fix the schedule first.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe we can focus on how to fix the schedule first.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: Stop fighting, both of you.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, I think we’re getting a little off track here.
feedback.explanation: “Stop fighting”像在训人；想调解时，可建议先分别说明问题，给双方具体的下一步。

turns.text: I just don’t like being blamed for something I didn’t do.

turns.prompt: 关于「两个同事吵架」，你想提出一个接下来的做法或安排，会怎么建议？

choices.text: That’s fair. Let’s separate the problem from who’s responsible for it.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fair. Let’s separate the problem from who’s responsible for it.
feedback.explanation: “responsible for”表示负责某项工作，能用来确认任务归属。

choices.text: I understand. But I think we can discuss that without blaming each other.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand. But I think we can discuss that without blaming each other.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: Why don’t we go through the timeline together?

feedback.naturalExpression: Why don’t we go through the timeline together?
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: Let’s figure out what needs to happen next, then we can talk about how this happened.

feedback.naturalExpression: Let’s figure out what needs to happen next, then we can talk about how this happened.
feedback.explanation: “figure out”表示想明白或弄清楚，强调经过思考找到办法。

turns.text: Fine. We need the new schedule by tomorrow.

turns.prompt: 关于「两个同事吵架」，你想提出一个接下来的做法或安排，会怎么建议？

choices.text: Okay. Let’s start there. What needs to be changed?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Let’s start there. What needs to be changed?
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: Great. That’s something we can actually solve right now.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. That’s something we can actually solve right now.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: All right. Maybe we can divide up the work and get it done today.

feedback.naturalExpression: All right. Maybe we can divide up the work and get it done today.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

scenarios.title: C｜被要求站队
scenarios.setting: 争执结束后，其中一个同事私下找到玩家。

turns.text: Be honest. You think Mia was wrong too, right?

turns.prompt: 你想说出自己的偏好或顾虑，会怎么表达？

choices.text: I don’t really want to take sides.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t really want to take sides.
feedback.explanation: “take sides”表示在争执中选边站；拒绝这样做，可以把讨论重新引向具体事情。

choices.text: I think both of you had valid points.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think both of you had valid points.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I understand why you’re frustrated, but I don’t think it’s that simple.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand why you’re frustrated, but I don’t think it’s that simple.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: I’d rather not get in the middle of this.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d rather not get in the middle of this.
feedback.explanation: “in the middle of”表示在过程中途，能指出故障或中断发生的阶段。

choices.text: Yes, but don’t tell her I said that.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t really want to take sides.
feedback.explanation: 要求对方保密仍在传递他人的评价，容易把自己卷入八卦；想保持中立应避免替双方传话。

turns.text: Come on. You can tell me what you really think.

turns.prompt: 你想坚持不选边站的立场，会怎么说？

choices.text: That is what I really think. I don’t want to choose sides.

feedback.naturalExpression: That is what I really think. I don’t want to choose sides.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t want to”明确表达自己的意愿或界限，后面的具体动作说明拒绝的是哪件事。

choices.text: Honestly, I think this is something you should talk to Mia about directly.

feedback.naturalExpression: Honestly, I think this is something you should talk to Mia about directly.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I can listen if you need to vent, but I don’t want to speak badly about her.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can listen if you need to vent, but I don’t want to speak badly about her.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: I’m happy to talk about what happened, but I’m not going to pick a side.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m happy to talk about what happened, but I’m not going to pick a side.
feedback.explanation: “pick a side”表示在争执中选边站；拒绝这样做，可以把讨论重新引向具体事情。

turns.text: Fine. I just wanted to know if I was being unreasonable.

turns.prompt: 你想从双方的感受出发评价刚才的争执，会怎么说？

choices.text: I think you were both frustrated, and the conversation got heated.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think you were both frustrated, and the conversation got heated.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I don’t think either of you handled it perfectly.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t think either of you handled it perfectly.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: If you want my opinion, I think talking to her once you’ve both cooled down would help.

feedback.naturalExpression: If you want my opinion, I think talking to her once you’ve both cooled down would help.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I get why you’re upset. I just don’t think blaming each other is going to fix it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I get why you’re upset. I just don’t think blaming each other is going to fix it.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

turns.text: Yeah. Maybe I’ll talk to her tomorrow.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方准备再沟通的打算，会怎么说？

choices.text: That sounds like a good idea.

feedback.naturalExpression: That sounds like a good idea.
feedback.explanation: “sounds like”表示根据对方的描述形成的印象，不是声称自己已经直接了解全部情况。

choices.text: Tomorrow might be better once things have settled down.

feedback.naturalExpression: Tomorrow might be better once things have settled down.
feedback.explanation: “settled down”表示情况平静下来，适合说明等情绪缓和后再继续沟通。
